kind: small in-process unmanaged diagnostic; not the published table-mode benchmark
types: BIGINT; generated exact values, no NULLs

method.writes: one timed store.insertRows call per revision, including key preflight; conversion/input construction excluded; source scripts unchanged
method.reads: three full-result SELECT * trials per reader count; one reader issues one scan; four readers process eight disjoint BETWEEN ranges; pre-opened connections, includes Arrow conversion and sqlHarness string rendering; no warmup
method.validation: all stored HASH fields compared with input outside timing; complete query values and multiplicities compared outside timing; timings never assert a test threshold
method.order: candidate experiments, then base, then final candidate; shared workstation; observational, not confidence intervals

limitations: not an end-to-end SQL/Arrow ingest benchmark
